name: What is the difference between a home office addition and a renovation of an existing room?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a home office addition and a renovation of an existing room?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home office addition involves expanding your home's footprint by building a new structure or extending an existing one to create dedicated office space. This typically offers more flexibility in design, size, and location, allowing for a completely custom environment. In contrast, renovating an existing room means converting an already built space within your home into an office. While often less costly and quicker, it's limited by the existing room's dimensions and structural constraints. We can help assess which option best suits your needs and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: An addition builds new space, offering more design freedom, while a renovation converts an existing room, limited by its current structure.
